preConditions.onFailMessage: Practice-review job admission provenance already exists

changeSet.comment: Carry the admitting rollout revision and trigger provenance on every practice-review job.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE agent_job SET practice_rollout_revision = -1 WHERE status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'COMPLETED');
ALTER TABLE agent_job ADD CONSTRAINT chk_agent_job_practice_trigger_mode CHECK (practice_trigger_mode IN ('AUTO', 'MANUAL'));

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Keep an immutable ordered explanation of each practice-feedback policy decision.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE delivery_policy_evaluation ADD CONSTRAINT sfk_delivery_policy_eval_feedback FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, feedback_id) REFERENCES feedback (workspace_id, id) ON DELETE SET NULL (feedback_id);

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Reconcile automatic and approved artifact comments through shared durable dispatch units.
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_feedback_dispatch_projection ON feedback_dispatch (updated_at) WHERE projected_at IS NULL AND state IN ('SENT', 'SUPPRESSED', 'FAILED');

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Keep the exact summary, inline comments, and reviewed revision in one approval package.
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM feedback_placement duplicate USING feedback_placement canonical WHERE duplicate.feedback_id = canonical.feedback_id AND duplicate.posted_comment_ref = canonical.posted_comment_ref AND duplicate.posted_comment_ref IS NOT NULL AND duplicate.id > canonical.id;
